name: Modern Power BI features
tagline: Visual calculations, Copilot workflows and their limits, paginated reports, mobile and accessible design, personalization, and AI-assisted analysis.
seo: Modern Power BI practice for PL-300: visual calculations, Copilot in Power BI, paginated reports, mobile layouts, accessibility, personalization, automatic page refresh, forecasting, anomaly detection, clustering and AI visuals.
intro: Product features layered on top of the fundamentals, most of them new to the PL-300 outline in April 2026. They don't replace a good model or correct DAX: Copilot answers better on a well-prepared model, and visual calculations are easier precisely because the model underneath is right. Each topic says when it was last checked against Microsoft's documentation, because these features change monthly.
setup: Power BI Desktop (current monthly release) and the starter project. Copilot needs a paid Fabric capacity (F2 or higher) or Power BI Premium (P1 or higher): trial capacities and Pro/PPU licences alone aren't enough. Where you don't have it, the tasks describe what to evaluate.
